# Mel McCutcheon

> Mel McCutcheon is a jazz vocalist based on Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada. She fronts The Sharp Seven, leads the Mel McCutcheon Ensembles (duo, trio and quartet) and sings with Vintage Velvet. She is also jam band manager and host with Blackbird Productions, a live jazz and community events venture in Campbell River and Comox, BC.

Bookings: productionsbyblackbird@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Mel McCutcheon, jazz vocalist](https://mel-mccutcheon.vercel.app/): about Mel, her bands (The Sharp Seven, Mel McCutcheon Ensembles, Vintage Velvet), upcoming and past shows, audience reviews, photos and booking contact.
- [Blackbird Productions](https://mel-mccutcheon.vercel.app/blackbird): live jazz on Vancouver Island. Sunday matinees at 40 Knots Winery (Comox) and Rivercity Players (Campbell River), Jazz Nights and open Jazz Jams at The Mex Pub (Courtenay), the Winter Jazz Sessions, featured artists, venues and a monthly community jazz calendar.
